tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Retrieve an existing Trace payment trace by its trace_id (tr_...), including the stage timeline. Read-only. Same normalized representation as trace_payment.

tools.name: list_supported_systems
tools.description: List what Trace supports and can do: assets (USDC), chains with public tracing (Base, Solana), providers requiring connected credentials (Bridge, Circle), and explicit capability flags (read-only; cannot send, retry, or sign). Call this when unsure whether a payment is in scope for trace_payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_supported_systems" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
